dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, I need your help. There's a mystery in my new apartment.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪ ˈniːd jʊr ˈhɛlp. ðɛrz ə ˈmɪstəri ɪn maɪ ˈnuː əˈpɑːrtmənt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Every night around two a.m., I hear strange noises in my bedroom wall.
dialogue.reading: ˈɛvri ˈnaɪt əˈraʊnd ˈtuː ˌeɪˈɛm, aɪ ˈhɪr ˈstreɪndʒ ˈnɔɪzɪz ɪn maɪ ˈbɛdruːm ˈwɔːl.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Knocking, and sometimes scratching. It's really mysterious.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːkɪŋ, ənd ˈsʌmtaɪmz ˈskrætʃɪŋ. ɪts ˈriːli mɪˈstɪriəs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: There must be a logical explanation. Who lives upstairs?
dialogue.reading: ðɛr mʌst bi ə ˈlɑːdʒɪkəl ˌɛkspləˈneɪʃən. ˈhuː ˈlɪvz ˌʌpˈstɛrz?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No one. The apartment above mine is empty.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ ˌwʌn. ði əˈpɑːrtmənt əˈbʌv ˈmaɪn ɪz ˈɛmpti.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then it must be the wind. Is your building old?
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ɪt mʌst bi ðə ˈwɪnd. ɪz jʊr ˈbɪldɪŋ ˈoʊld?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, very old. But the wind doesn't knock at two a.m. every night!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈvɛri ˈoʊld. bʌt ðə ˈwɪnd ˈdʌzənt ˈnɑːk ət ˈtuː ˌeɪˈɛm ˈɛvri ˈnaɪt!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK, then it must be something inside the wall.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ, ˈðɛn ɪt mʌst bi ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˌɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈwɔːl.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Inside the wall? That's a strange thought!
dialogue.reading: ˌɪnˈsaɪd ðə ˈwɔːl? ðæts ə ˈstreɪndʒ ˈθɔːt!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Don't worry. I'll come over tonight, and we'll listen together.
dialogue.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈwɜːri. aɪl ˈkʌm ˈoʊvər təˈnaɪt, ənd wiːl ˈlɪsən təˈɡɛðər.
